Retirement.tip: Configure Robinhood credentials in ~/.config/retirement/config.toml before first run.

Monster.tip: Configure database path in config if not using default SQLite location.

MailVault.tip: Run 'mailvault sync' after install to do initial IMAP sync. Config lives in ~/.config/mailvault/.

WarpStrand-Driver.tip: Installs to ~/TankuOS/Apps/warpstrand-driver/ with isolated venv and config migration.
